# gns3_image (Resource)

An emulator image (qemu disk or ISO, IOU binary, Dynamips IOS image) on a GNS3 compute. The provider reads the file from `source_url` or `source_path`, checks `md5sum` when it is set, and uploads it with `POST /v2/computes/{compute_id}/{emulator}/images/{filename}`. An image already on the compute with the same MD5 is adopted without an upload.

**Destroy leaves the file on the compute.** GNS3 2.2 has no API to delete an image, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and warns. Delete the file on the compute's file system if you no longer need it.

Docker images are not covered: GNS3 pulls them itself when a Docker node is created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# VyOS rolling release ISO (about 612 MiB) from the official nightly builds.
# Rolling builds are removed after a few months: pick a current one at
# https://vyos.net/get/nightly-builds/ and update both names below.
resource "gns3_image" "vyos" {
  compute_id = "local"
  emulator   = "qemu"
  filename   = "vyos-2026.10.07-0712-rolling-generic-amd64.iso"
  source_url = "https://github.com/vyos/vyos-nightly-build/releases/download/2026.10.07-0712-rolling/vyos-2026.10.07-0712-rolling-generic-amd64.iso"

  # VyOS signs its builds with minisign rather than publishing an MD5. After
  # checking the signature, set md5sum to pin the content:
  # (Get-FileHash <iso> -Algorithm MD5).Hash.ToLower()
  # md5sum = "..."
}

# MikroTik CHR from a file on the machine running Terraform (unzip
# chr-7.24.5.img.zip from https://mikrotik.com/download first). With md5sum
# taken from the file itself, replacing the local file uploads it again.
resource "gns3_image" "chr" {
  emulator    = "qemu"
  filename    = "chr-7.24.5.img"
  source_path = "${path.module}/images/chr-7.24.5.img"
  md5sum      = filemd5("${path.module}/images/chr-7.24.5.img")
}

# Destroying either resource leaves the file on the compute: GNS3 2.2 has no
# API to delete images.
```

## Schema

### Required

- `emulator` (String) Emulator whose images folder receives the file: one of `qemu`, `iou`, `dynamips`. `iou` exists only on Linux computes such as the GNS3 VM. The `dynamips` and `iou` lists show only ELF executables, so other files upload but are never found. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `filename` (String) File name on the compute, at the top of the emulator's images folder (no `/` or `\`). This is the name templates refer to. Changing it replaces the resource (the old file stays).

### Optional

- `compute_id` (String) Compute to upload to, for example `local` or `vm`. Default `local`. Changing it replaces the resource (the copy on the old compute stays there).
- `md5sum` (String) Expected MD5 of the image, lower-case hex. When set, the source is checked against it after the download and before the upload, and the apply fails on a mismatch. Changing it uploads the source again, overwriting the file; so does a refresh that finds a different MD5 on the compute. When unset, it is the MD5 the compute reports and the file's content is not managed after the first upload.
- `source_path` (String) Local path, on the machine running Terraform, of the image to upload. Exactly one of `source_url` and `source_path` must be set. Changing it alone does nothing; change `md5sum` too to upload the new file.
- `source_url` (String) `http` or `https` URL to download the image from, to a temporary file that is removed afterwards. Exactly one of `source_url` and `source_path` must be set. Changing it alone does nothing; change `md5sum` too to upload the new file.

### Read-Only

- `filesize` (Number) File size in bytes, as the compute reports it.
- `path` (String) Path the compute reports, relative to the emulator's images folder (`QEMU`, `IOU` or `IOS`); the file name itself.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <compute_id>/<emulator>/<filename>. The image must already be on
# the compute. Set source_url or source_path in the configuration afterwards;
# the first plan then shows it as an in-place change that uploads nothing.
terraform import gns3_image.vyos local/qemu/vyos-2026.10.07-0712-rolling-generic-amd64.iso
```
